info.name: Tell Do Gong I Said Hi

descriptions.notStarted: Will #b#p2071006##k of #b#m222000000##k regain its lost memory?
descriptions.inProgress: #p2071006# told me it now remembers everything that has to do with #b#m250000000##k and #b#p2091001##k, and felt saddened that it hadn't been able to repay #p2091001# for all the good things he did for it due to the injury, and wanted me to say HI to him for it.
descriptions.completed: I managed to relay #p2071006#'s greetings to #p2091001#. #p2091001# seemed shocked by #p2071006#'s injuries, and wished it a speedy recovery by asking me to deliver #b#p2091002##k to it. Okay, I better go back to #b#p2091002##k, now.
